drk.text: Lord Peemel, ruler of Iwset, proposes marriage to Lady Edara, and when she refuses his hand, he declares war on Jehesic.
He claims the city's sigil is the key to the Tomb of the Seven Martyrs, tasks Maeveen and Vervamon with finding it, and orders Sacumon to sow chaos in the north by pitting minotaurs against elves.
After Jehesic captures Ihesia, Peemel counterattacks and kidnaps Lady Edara, but Digody stabs him in the back, killing him.
